test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The total number of colour blocks is 6409. If the ratio of red blocks to blue blocks is 7 : 5 and the ratio of blue blocks to yellow blocks is 8 : 4, then how many yellow blocks are there?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Merge ratios: R : B = 7 : 5 and B : Y = 8 : 4 (or 2 : 1).

R : B : Y = (7 × 8) : (5 × 8) : (5 × 4) = 56 : 40 : 20 = 14 : 10 : 5.

Total units = 14 + 10 + 5 = 29 units.

29 units = 6409 ⇒ 1 unit = 221.

Yellow blocks = 5 × 221 = 1105.

**∴ The correct answer is 1105.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total colour blocks = 6409

Ratio of Red : Blue = 7 : 5

Ratio of Blue : Yellow = 8 : 4

**Formula Used:**

If A : B = x : y and B : C = p : q, then A : B : C = (x × p) : (y × p) : (y × q)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fccc906ad8a691bed02ad03dd83696709a264278ab9f329455ba9e25f009a6.png] 

⇒ Red : Blue = 7 : 5

⇒ Blue : Yellow = 8 : 4 = 2 : 1

⇒ To make Blue parts equal, multiply (7 : 5) by 2 and (2 : 1) by 5.

⇒ Red : Blue = 14 : 10

⇒ Blue : Yellow = 10 : 5

⇒ Combined Ratio R : B : Y = 14 : 10 : 5

⇒ Sum of ratio parts = 14 + 10 + 5 = 29 units

⇒ 29 units = 6409

⇒ 1 unit = 6409 ÷ 29 = 221

⇒ Number of yellow blocks = 5 × 221

⇒ Yellow blocks = 1105

**∴ The correct answer is 1105.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Merging

To combine A:B and B:C into A:B:C, the common term (B) must have the same value in both ratios. Use the LCM of the B values to normalize.

Distribution based on Ratio

Value of a specific part = (Particular ratio part ÷ Sum of all ratio parts) × Total quantity.

Compound Ratio

The compound ratio of a:b and c:d is (a × c) : (b × d). It is the product of the individual ratios.
